basis.title: Energy Conservation Program: Energy Conservation Standards for Commercial Water Heating Equipment (final rule), 88 FR 69686, October 6, 2023
basis.label: "commercial electric and gas-fired storage water heaters ... estimated average useful lifetimes of these two types of equipment are 12 and 10 years"
basis.note: Printed page 69764. class: commercial electric storage water heaters. Stated in the shipments analysis; electric units were not regulated by this rule, so no LCC table covers them.

basis.title: Energy Conservation Program: Energy Conservation Standards for Consumer Water Heaters (final rule), 89 FR 37778, May 6, 2024
basis.label: "DOE estimates the average product lifetime to be around 15 years for storage water heaters"
basis.note: Printed page 37859. residential: consumer electric storage water heaters, including heat pump water heaters (DOE found no lifetime difference).

open_questions: HUD's row is for residential water heaters; commercial storage heaters may differ.
Every source here is a published planning, design or accounting life. None is observed replacement data.
Some maintenance intervals come from TM 5-692-1, an Army manual for mission-critical (C4ISR) facilities; they may be tighter than typical commercial practice.
